description: This file contains C source code implementing cache manipulation routines for an LZMA compressed kernel loader on Atheros ARM-based boards. It defines a cache flushing function that operates on memory addresses to ensure cache coherency, utilizing inline assembly for cache operations.

methods.name: void flush_cache(unsigned long start_addr,unsigned long size)
methods.description: Flushes a specified memory region from CPU cache to ensure coherency, using cache operations provided by inline assembly.
